method.screenshots: Inspected interactively; no standalone observation screenshots saved.
method.repeatOpenLimitation: All six explicit validations completed. An optional reopen pass was not completed because Acrobat subsequently disabled its Open and Close File menu commands. No repeated-run claim is made.

independentVerification.method: Strict pyHanko parsing, base-prefix hash and structural checks, OpenSSL cms -verify -binary -noverify (chain trust excluded).

interpretation.observed: S1-S4 INVALID; S5 and S6 VALID with subsequent changes. All identities trusted.
interpretation.sufficientConstruction: The supplied S6 combined construction and S5 qpdf rewrite each avoid the rejection. None of S1-S4 alone did so in this batch.
notEstablished: That all four S6 changes are necessary.
A universal Acrobat rule for every PDF or signing writer.
Permission to change validation policy based solely on this batch.
baseDetails: S1/S2/S3 start with %PDF-1.7 followed by CRLF, not bare CR. S4/S6 start with %PDF-1.7 followed by LF LF.
The first ID is 4 bytes in S1/S3/S4/S5; the second ID is 16 bytes in every base.
The successful S5 base retains a 4-byte first ID and no trailer Info. Those properties do not universally prevent successful later-update validation.
interpretation.categoryCaution: The five Annotations Modified rows are recorded as Acrobat UI output. Independent parsing found only a new unreferenced object in the final revision, with no existing object rewrite or effective trailer-value change apart from Size and Prev. The rows are not evidence that these fixtures actually edited five annotations after signing.
interpretation.nextExperiment: Use new fixture identifiers for S6 minus one fix at a time, preserving the passing S6 construction otherwise; add signed-only controls. Test smaller combinations once the drop-one results identify necessary components.
interpretation.missingBaseFiles: README mentions standalone base-*.pdf files, but none were supplied. Base prefixes were recovered in memory from the signed PDFs and matched to every manifest base_sha256. Signed-only controls were not separately opened in this round.
